editorial:
Ever wondered what happens when a guy's secret past comes back to haunt him in the worst way possible? You get to meet Hutch Rimes, an insurance agent who looks like he has it all together. He spends his days slacking off at a hotel with a rotating door of sexy secretaries, but he is hiding a dark secret from ten years ago. He tried to help a girlfriend get rid of her mean husband, but the plan went sideways. The husband ended up killing the girl by mistake, and Hutch walked away with a fat paycheck from a ranch deal. It sounds like he got away with it, but now someone is stalking him in the suburbs, and they are out for blood.

What makes this flick work is the weird mix of scary moments and dark jokes. Steven Weber is great at playing a guy who is both charming and kind of a jerk, and the supporting cast keeps the energy high. The pacing is quick, so you never get bored while trying to guess who the killer is. While the plot has some wild jumps, it is mostly just a fun ride. If you are in the mood for a suspenseful night, you should definitely try renting it on Apple TV or grabbing the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection to see all the details clearly.
endingExplained: The big twist reveals that the stalker is actually the woman Hutch thought was dead all those years ago. She faked her death to frame the husband and get revenge on everyone. In the final showdown, she tries to kill Hutch to take everything he has. However, Hutch manages to outsmart her in a chaotic struggle. He survives the encounter, and the movie ends with a sarcastic nod to the fact that bad people rarely get a happy ending.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark comedies and murder mysteries.
